reviewed_by: Claude Code, fixing a live Butler thread stuck on 'Butler is working…' after the 7453191 deploy
reason: After a deploy stopped Apple Bug Bounty's worker, Core auto-resumed the operator's Butler thread turn (direct lane) at 22:38, but it never reached provider admission: _run_provider_turn makes every automatic recovery take a process-wide 2-slot semaphore (_automatic_recovery_slots) before admission and holds it until the turn ends. Two recovered subagent children holding the slots for hours left the Butler turn FIFO-queued behind 9 more (expected start 1.5-10 h later). Two independent subagents validated this from provider_turn_queue and turn data (the 22:43:55 -> 22:43:56 slot handover). The code comment already says operator turns do not use this gate. Fix: recovered direct-lane turns skip the gate; background recovery (subagents, goals) keeps the 2-at-a-time bound. Selected: a new test that holds both recovery slots and asserts a recovered direct turn still runs (fails without the fix), the existing restart-recovery bound tests in test_chat.py (now explicitly background-lane recoveries, still asserting at most 2 run), and the admission-cleanup and Butler concurrent-recovery suites.
exclusions: Releasing the recovery slot at admission (so long background recoveries stop starving later ones) was tried and reverted: it removes the deliberate 2-running bound that test_core_restart_recovery_bounds_concurrent_provider_turns encodes for event-loop protection, so it needs its own design decision. tests/v3/test_chat.py::test_runtime_switch_to_equal_limits_needs_no_confirmation_over_target[postgresql] and tests/v3/test_butler_recovery.py::test_act_switches_worker_to_provider_and_queues_only_the_parent fail identically on pristine origin/main; PostgreSQL cases skip in CI without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL, and test_butler_recovery.py is not selected. No UI change.
